component.name: Tatakai Next
component.summary: Native anime player with libmpv and local extensions
Reproductor de anime nativo con libmpv y extensiones locales

description.p: Tatakai Next is the native desktop app of Tatakai: browse your library and history, play episodes with libmpv and Anime4K or FSR upscaling, and run sideloaded .kai extensions in a sandboxed host.
Three player modes are available in Settings:

ul.li: Embedded: libmpv drawn inside the app window, with the app controls.
Embedded enhanced: the same player with the bundled mpv-anime-build profiles, shaders and scripts.
External mpv: your own mpv, with your configuration and controls, in its own window.

description.p: Tatakai Next es la app nativa de escritorio de Tatakai: explora tu biblioteca e historial, reproduce episodios con libmpv y escalado Anime4K o FSR, y ejecuta extensiones .kai locales en un host aislado.
First Linux build: embedded, enhanced and external mpv player modes.
